title: Service IA Restructure + System Services Follow-through
acceptance_criteria: Global interface display uses Description (ethX) when description is available, excluding interface-description edit surfaces.
IPsec site-to-site wizard dialog is wide enough for readable proposal fields.
System Information dashboard card shows CPU temperature when available from VyOS.
Services are promoted in navigation with direct links to per-service views.
System Services page supports deep-linking via query tab values.
Dynamic DNS and DHCP Relay are configurable from GUI with backend read/update routes.
Power Mgmt placeholder tab is removed from System Services.
DDNS duplicate interface/provider entries are rejected and existing passwords are preserved on blank-password updates.
Disable operations for DDNS and DHCP relay succeed without validating stale payload entries.
assumptions: VyOS does not expose FreeBSD powerd controls in current service/API surface.
CPU temperature is best-effort and may be unavailable depending on hardware/virtualization.
DNS resolver behavior is represented by the same VyOS DNS service currently used by DNS forwarder controls.

tasks.notes: Mapped Mark's IA + telemetry + services follow-through requests into implementable increments.
Implemented DDNS/DHCP relay config routes, DDNS secret preservation, duplicate protection, and disable-path validation fixes.
Replaced placeholders with working tabs, mapped DNS resolver tab to real DNS config, removed Power Mgmt placeholder, and applied interface display labels in service interface pickers.
Added DDNS/DHCP relay route tests, duplicate rejection coverage, and disable edge-case coverage.
Backend tests pass (25 passed). Frontend typecheck/build/lint pass (lint warning debt unchanged).
Reviewer APPROVED after addressing disable-path and duplicate-entry issues.
Next increment planning: DHCP UX overhaul, firewall-zone guide/help page, and remaining DNS/service requests from Mark backlog.
